item.text: The current loader writes every successfully parsed config during initialization, even when it is already current, and serialization currently walks the class instance. I’m checking the existing migration tests and call sites before replacing that with a single persisted config object and explicit constructor inputs.

item.text: The main load path now builds one config object, restores `_credentials` as a `Map`, and writes only when migration, malformed/missing data, or a missing signup token requires it. I found one legacy migration path that discarded credentials for versions below 2; I’m removing that loss and checking the repository’s test runner commands.

item.text:
Updated [DeviceConfig.ts](/app/src/misc/DeviceConfig.ts) to keep persisted fields in one config object, use the required underscored keys, restore credentials as a `Map`, preserve legacy fields during migration, and avoid writes on unchanged current configs. The global instance now receives explicit version and storage parameters.

`npx tsc --noEmit --pretty false` passed. The client test runner did not complete: its build stalled while compiling the native `better-sqlite3` dependency.
